target.title: feat: show cloud workspace conflicts in the Control UI
target.body:
Related: #110224 (phase 3 of 3; phases 1 and 2 were #110952 and #111244)

## What Problem This Solves

Completes the operator-facing recovery path for cloud workspace conflicts. The Gateway already keeps local versions, applies non-conflicting cloud changes, preserves the cloud result under a staged Git ref, and records the conflict in the session; the Control UI previously left that recovery state hidden in raw placement and transcript data.

## Why This Change Was Made

The Control UI now turns the existing phase-2 conflict projection into a warning sidebar badge and a dismissible chat notice with a bounded path list, staged-result ref, and copyable inspect/take-cloud commands. The durable custom transcript entry renders as a structured conflict event, so the explanation remains visible after the live placement notice is cleared. No protocol or persistence shape changes are introduced in this phase.

## User Impact

Operators can see that a cloud turn completed with workspace conflicts, identify which local paths were kept, inspect the staged cloud version, and deliberately take that version when appropriate. Non-conflicting cloud changes are already applied, and the UI explains deletion, file/directory obstruction, shell, and stale-ref cases without requiring a blind retry.

## Evidence

- Focused Control UI proof after rebasing onto current `origin/main`: 3 files passed, 294 tests passed (`node scripts/run-vitest.mjs ui/src/components/session-row-badges.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/chat-view.test.ts ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-message.test.ts`).
- Structured AutoReview (`--mode branch --base origin/main`, Codex `gpt-5.6-sol`): clean, no accepted/actionable findings; overall verdict `patch is correct` (0.94 confidence).
- Rebase retained current-main inline approval cards and approval badges while adding the conflict UI; the landed phase-2 contract remains `workspaceResultConflict` / `cloud-workspace-conflict` with `paths`, `stagedResultRef`, and `totalCount`.
- Visual capture gap: the required existing-Chrome DevTools bridge timed out and Chrome exposed no shareable window to the approved local UI automation path, so no sanitized before/after images could be attached from this run. The focused rendering tests assert the visible banner, bounded paths, staged ref, commands, dismiss action, sidebar badge, and transcript event.

AI-assisted: yes. The rebased diff was reviewed and validated before publication.
